title: Extract variables
tagline: One feature per block of the tree that turns what its features produced into named variables and query variables -- regions, cuts, chain ends, the largest faces -- instead of a query variable per name. Can also set variables across a Derive.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: A variable-driven model needs dozens of named selections so later features keep working when the model changes. Native query variables give one node per name, picked by hand, and cannot express a region, a chain end or 'the two largest faces'. Extract variables publishes them all from one node, from what the source features published.
useWhen: A block of features feeds many later selections
A selection must be computed (region, chain end, largest N)
slides.caption: Examples studio: Show highlights what the entries publish; 'Published 6 name(s).'

points.head: Producers
points.body: Our features publish keys (output, regions, cuts, ends ...) in a hidden map; built-ins still offer output and modified* keys.

points.head: Addresses
points.body: A key offered by one source is its bare name; by several, key@1, key@2 ... (Print keys lists them).

points.head: Always present
points.body: A producer's keys exist even when empty, so an entry never breaks after an edit.

points.head: Hold (default)
points.body: What was there, followed through edits that keep it -- verified: follows a 10 mm Move boundary extend.

points.head: Track
points.body: Also what later splits and rebuilds make of it.

points.head: Evaluate on use
points.body: Re-resolved wherever used: the most live, and the easiest to get wrong.

slides.title: The dialog
params: The features to read (sorted by tree order).
Button: one entry per address not yet listed.
Per name: Type, Source key, Published name, Show, Evaluate on use, Track; Filtered adds entity type, body type, name, largest N.
Get variables from a derived Part Studio
Default off. On: shows Derived Part Studio (and its configuration) and sets that studio's exported variables here.
List every address with its description.
Optional: one map variable listing everything published, derived names included.
slides.note: Entry types: Source key, Filtered, Closest to point, Shared edges, Chain end, Edges between points, Bridging curve input, Region.

slides.title: Example: box bands
slides.head: Sources: a Box and a split of its faces into bands; prefix 'box'
slides.body: Entries publish the body (output@1), the two largest faces (Filtered, keep 2), the edges at a corner (Closest to point), shared edges and two regions -- 6 names, plus a manifest. With Show on, the published body and cuts are highlighted.

slides.title: Across a Derive: the two sides

points.head: Source studio (producer)
points.body: Add variables for derive or Variable + with Export for derive write one map variable, exportVariables (name to value).

points.head: Deriving studio (consumer)
points.body: Extract variables with "Get variables from a derived Part Studio" ticked and the source picked: it sets an ordinary variable of the same name for each entry.

points.head: Status
points.body: Not run live: pushed to the workspace only, unverified end to end.

slides.title: Add variables for derive (producer)
params: Source studio, after the variables it lists.
List; each item is a Variable name (set earlier in this studio, no #; autocomplete).
Reads each current value and merges it into exportVariables; a name listed twice: the later wins.
Value at the feature's position; later edits are not seen. Numbers, lengths, angles, text, maps only.
Variable 'x' is not set before this feature / is a query / 'exportVariables' is the registry itself.

slides.title: Variable + (Export for derive)
params: Assigned / Measured / From import; Distance, Length, Diameter, Angle, Radius of curvature, Point coordinate.
Distance and point coordinate: one mate connector; X/Y/Z/Delta signed along its axes.
Boolean: adds the value to exportVariables. A Map export is untested; live tests (8/8) did not cover this tick.
slides.note: Lives in the betterMeasure document; a user version is needed before other documents see these options.

keys: A value entry: an ordinary variable.
A query entry: a native query variable, in the dropdowns of later features.
One map variable listing everything published.
Derive option: one ordinary variable per entry of the source studio's exportVariables map, same name, description "From derived Part Studio"; an existing variable of that name is overwritten.

items.head: Press Add keys, then prune
items.body: It lists everything the sources offer; delete what you do not need and rename the rest.

items.head: Prefer Hold
items.body: Use Track for things later split; Evaluate on use only when you know why.

items.head: Adding a source
items.body: Every source offers output: a second source makes the bare 'output' ambiguous -- use output@1.

items.head: Derive: values only
items.body: Only ordinary values cross a Derive; query variables cannot. Snapshots taken at the producer's position in the source studio. Costs one extra regeneration of the source studio.

items.head: Derive path: not run live
items.body: Pushed to the Variable_tools workspace, not versioned. Unverified: a custom feature building the other studio, producer variables visible there, configured studios. Try a scratch pair first.
